sequence: Original viewed first, then hero and all nine individual candidate PNGs; no baseline, prior scores or construction prose read before freeze.

observations.silhouette: Recognizable bell-bearing wreck guardian with stout feet and tall broken timbers, but side views read a long, boxy quadruped carrying a fence. Original is a more compact, heavy crab-like mass with crouched splayed limbs and irregular scaffold.
observations.face: Descending woody central muzzle and orange squint are readable, especially hero/front. Long narrow wedge and nearly horizontal lower jaw in side views still read reptilian. Ivory forms cluster as two long pendant tusks instead of the original broad jagged interlocking jaw; brow plates dominate the eye.
observations.details: Bell flare, bands, clapper, rope wraps, angular feet and wreck beams survive. Cage rails are overly parallel and regular; back has large plain end-cap shapes and sparse lashings relative to original tangled wreck character.
observations.facet: Strong coherent flat-shaded warm wood, teal bell, pale bindings and dark stone feet. Some large planar planks and shallow ornamental chips remain mechanically regular; this score does not credit geometry proofs.
